findings: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate learned through Turles training. The user first holds a barrier that absorbs attacks, then thrusts the hand forward to create a large Ki ball that erupts into a pillar. Current evidence documents 42 hits and approximately 80% total damage, with additional input allowing the sequence to fire faster.
